integrity: The separation is proved by an explicit rank-two transformation and a generator-invariant family of ordered subset pairs. A standalone verifier reconstructs A4, the generated transformation monoid, the indistinguishable witness pair, and an exhaustive rank-two/rank-three stress test.
scientific_limitations: The result proves only that strongly sync-maximal permutation groups form a proper subclass of primitive groups. It does not determine whether the class properly contains the 4-transitive groups or classify higher-degree cases.
title: \(A_4\) separates strong sync-maximality from primitivity
